did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. Two MPOs (Anwar in Uttara, Kabir in Mirpur) each had Napa 500 mg on the market, Anwar's with a 10+2 bonus. Wholesale buyer Rahim Traders searched Napa and bid 15% on one and 18% on the other. A second wholesale account then searched and bid 10%. Kabir looked at his bids and accepted the 15% one. The owner looked at the offers.

checks.text: The second wholesaler, searching the same medicine, sees the two offers with no sign of Rahim's offers
Each wholesaler sees only their own offer: "Your offer: 10% off, 1 boxes. Waiting." on the second account, and Rahim's own 15% and 18% on his
The MPO sees the bids without names and accepts one; the owner alone sees which shop offered how much

notes: Done by hand in the live browser, not by a script.

Fault found and fixed here: after a wholesaler sent or withdrew an offer, the search result on the order page was not read again, so the row did not say "Your offer: ... Waiting" and had no Withdraw button until the page was reloaded. The row now updates at once.

shots.caption: A second wholesaler sees the offers, with no one else's bid
After bidding, this account sees only its own 10%
Rahim sees only his own 15% and 18%
The owner sees the real name next to the offer
